purpose: Map current grounded-QA distillation artifacts to manuscript claims, tables, and blocked claims without overclaiming missing Qwen 3B results.

dataset_and_temporal_claims.allowed_claim: The final evaluation window is a public, dated arXiv/QASPER proxy for an evolving domain KB, not a private enterprise KB.

zero_call_risk_gate_transfer.scope: extended_temporal_future_holdout examples 241-389, excluding the threshold-selection window
zero_call_risk_gate_transfer.interpretation: Support-aware zero-call gating improves judged correctness and answer support over direct mini repair, but trades off answer coverage and recall.

deterministic_claim_entailment_guard.interpretation: A deterministic claim/evidence guard adds a small support gain over the balanced gate, again by suppressing answers.

mini_verifier_teacher_step.interpretation: The mini verifier is useful as a label-construction or teacher step, not as the final amortized student because it adds per-query LLM calls.

post_training_policy_ablation.qwen3b_acceptance_metric: The trained Qwen3B student must improve support/correctness over direct compact-RAG labels without collapsing answer coverage to the zero-call gate floor.
post_training_policy_ablation.interpretation: Historical judged ablation says support-risk contrast is the strongest data-construction direction, but the final trained student must recover coverage rather than only learning to abstain.

coverage_constrained_frontier.qwen3b_recommended_minimum: Beat the direct baseline on answer support and overall judged correctness while keeping answer rate above 70%; if that is not possible, report the exact coverage/support frontier instead of claiming support-preserving distillation.
coverage_constrained_frontier.interpretation: The support/coverage tradeoff is binding; Qwen 3B should be compared against a 70% answer-rate frontier, not only against the low-coverage support-first gate.

joint_action_packet_quality.interpretation: The Qwen 3B packet passes a zero-cost pre-launch audit for repair/abstain preference coverage, inline citations, and train/eval paper separation.

drag_like.claim: A DRAG-like comparison should be framed as a close baseline family, but the novel target is support-preserving data construction over evolving/private KBs. The next model result must show whether joint-action SFT/DPO improves support without relying on per-query teacher or verifier calls.

longcite_style.headline: Citation syntax compliance is not a proxy for grounded answer support.

writeback_scope.scoped_reason: A mutable write-back memory would change the retrieval corpus and can leak final-window facts unless it is built strictly from prior dated/private snapshots. The current QASPER/arXiv-id temporal split is not a trusted dated/private KB snapshot, so a full write-back baseline would overclaim evolving-KB validity.

blocked_claims: A trained Qwen 3B joint-action student improves citation-grounded correctness.
Joint-action SFT/DPO preserves support better than the zero-call scaffold baselines.

constraints: Call current support/correctness metrics model-judged, not human-validated.
Report answer rate, abstention support, answer support, and second-pass disagreement together for any gate that suppresses answers.
Do not claim abstention-boundary calibration is solved; describe it as an open limitation.
Use the second-pass disagreement examples to motivate the Qwen 3B joint-action objective rather than another pure suppression gate.
judge_reliability_constraints.interpretation: The second-pass judge supports reporting unsupported-answer checks, but abstention-boundary claims remain unstable and must be caveated.

evidence: public arXiv proxy, not private KB

allowed_claims_now: Support-aware local scaffolds can improve judged correctness over direct mini repair on dated QASPER/arXiv future windows, at a clear coverage cost.
Citation formatting alone is insufficient: high inline citation compliance can coexist with very low judged answer support.
A blind second-pass judge agrees with the original support judge on many hard unsupported-answer and sanity-check cases, but abstention-boundary cases remain unstable.
The current protocol has a trusted dated public-KB proxy and explicit budget accounting, but not yet the final trained Qwen 3B student result.
claims_to_avoid_until_qwen3b: A smaller trained model has been shown to preserve citation-grounded correctness.
Joint-action SFT/DPO beats the existing scaffolds.
The work is ready as a NeurIPS submission.
The evaluation proves behavior over private enterprise KBs rather than a public dated proxy.

llm_budget.note: This manuscript evidence map reads local artifacts only.
